parts.html: The K-13 kitchen model combines warm beige tones, minimalist design, and a practical layout to create a refined and functional kitchen interior. Its light solid-color finish gives the composition a calm and elegant appearance, while the island adds both convenience and a stronger architectural presence.

The beige palette creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere, making this kitchen well suited for contemporary apartments, private residences, and open-plan living spaces. This neutral tone pairs naturally with wood textures, light stone, decorative plaster, and modern interior materials.

A defining feature of the K-13 model is its straight-line kitchen layout combined with a separate island. The main kitchen run organizes work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage along one wall, while the island provides an additional functional zone for food preparation and everyday use.

The upper cabinet fronts are made from acrylic-faced MDF panels, while the lower cabinet fronts use HPL panels on an MDF substrate. This combination creates a modern visual identity and also supports practical everyday use. The solid-color finish unifies all elements into one cohesive minimalist composition.

The compact laminate countertop reinforces the contemporary character of the model and provides a durable work surface. The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard. FREE FOLD Hafele lift mechanisms allow convenient access to the upper cabinets, while Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges ensure smooth door operation.

Muller Box Profi Line drawers complete the functional storage system and improve everyday comfort. The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Pull-out cargo storage is not included, and cabinet handles are part of the standard configuration.
Upper cabinet fronts: Acrylic-faced MDF panels
Lower cabinet fronts: HPL panels on MDF substrate
Drawer system: Muller Box Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-13 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client’s requirements.
Order your K-13 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a stylish minimalist interior with practical island functionality.
